regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate current-method claim (TFMS, Rh/L, up to 76%, complete regiocontrol). The graphic is a generic summary and not a separate experiment.
The Pd/Ir allenylic functionalization arrow is explicitly Ma and Carreira prior work and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.
The Rh/L-TFMS arrow is the generic current reaction class; Table 1, Scheme 2, and Scheme 3 provide experiment-specific records.

The main text reports complete recovery of an allenylic ester and failed Pd/Ir attempts, but directs all separable conditions to Table S1. Because no SI file is explicitly associated, no SI-only run details or duplicate records were inferred.

unresolved: Table S1 is not associated in the workspace, so the exact leaving groups, catalyst identities per failed run, quantities, conditions, and recovery/yield bases remain unavailable.
Generic Scheme 1 structures contain R/PG/Nu labels and do not define unique molecules.

regions.region: page 2 left Table 1 reaction header, ligand drawings, entries 1-17, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: All 17 optimization rows were recorded independently with shared substrate/TFMS/Rh/CsF/CH3CN conditions, row-specific catalyst/ligand/silver salt/PTC, footnote temperature and equivalent overrides, 19F-NMR yields, and benzotrifluoride measurement basis.
Narrative yields and ligand/additive effects map to the Table 1 rows and were not duplicated. L4/L5 low-yield rows remain numeric experiments rather than being converted to qualitative failure.

regions.finding: Recorded the independent 4.5 mmol scale-up to 3n with explicit catalysts/additives, -40 °C, 68% yield, and 1.05 g product. Missing TFMS amount, solvent volume, time, and yield basis were not inherited from Scheme 2.
The prose confirms the product-specific Scheme 2 yields, functional-group classes, and independent 3n scale-up; it adds no extra separable scope runs beyond the displayed rows.
